# [CS083] Self Assignment (go.correctness.self-assignment)

A variable or field is assigned to itself.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | LOW |
| **Category** | Correctness |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

x = x has no effect. It usually hides a typo, such as assigning a field to itself instead of copying it from a parameter, which leaves the field at its zero value.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
func (s *Server) SetTimeout(timeout time.Duration) {
	s.timeout = s.timeout
}
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
func (s *Server) SetTimeout(timeout time.Duration) {
	s.timeout = timeout
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [go.correctness.self-assignment]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    go.correctness.self-assignment: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore go.correctness.self-assignment -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** go.correctness.self-assignment
```
